notes:
Summary: Pelago ThreadGlean builds summarization + auto-tagging middleware that plugs into Zendesk/Freshdesk. Primary ask = accurate ticket & email summarization, automated tag suggestions and macros, high reliability during marketing/customer incident spikes.

Customer quotes: "We want concise TL;DR + tags for faster triage — 1–2 lines for agents, structured metadata for routing."

Key constraints: must keep PII out of model logs, need SSO + org-wide SAML, audit trail of inference events, ability to pin models and fall back to smaller quantized model when capacity tight. Data residency: EU customers live in eu region, they want option to keep EU ticket data within eu.

Performance targets: asynchronous summarization for backlog: 1k tickets/min sustained; real-time agent-assist: p95 < 700ms, p50 < 250ms; spike capacity target = 3x baseline traffic for 30 minutes (marketing / promo spikes). Cost posture: moderate — willing to commit to Dedicated if unit economics show 30–40% cost savings vs current cloud infra.

Integration notes: prefer a Zendesk app + webhook ingestion path; Freshdesk also supported for a subset of customers. Workflows: macros auto-created from common intents, auto-tagging into candidate taxonomy (product, severity, request_type). POC scope: 6 months of anonymized tickets (ingest pipeline), sample tag taxonomy (~40 tags), 500 live agent-assist sessions/day.

Security/legal: legal needs signed DPA + SOC2 evidence before prod. Security team wants KMS integration for key rotation and per-tenant encryption. Also asked for explainability sample logs for 100 random inferences.

Internal notes (AE/SE): Lina ran model selection session 2026-02-18 — recommended trying a quantized 7B variant for auto-tagging and a 13B for summarization with prefix caching. Propose canary that routes 10% of live traffic to Redwood-hosted model, fallback to cached responses if timeout. SE to script spike test (load profile attached in Drive).

PoC success metrics: tag precision > 0.85, recall > 0.75; agent time saved >= 20%; no more than 2 production incidents during 30-min spike test.

Next steps (short): legal NDA routing (owner: Jordan), schedule spike-run with infra (target week of 2026-03-15), deliver POC pricing and SOW draft, request Zendesk app sandbox approval.
